mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP450 enzymes (sertraline: CYP2D6, CYP3A4; chloroquine: CYP3A4, CYP2D6) and can prolong QT interval, with additive cardiac and CNS effects.
action: Monitor ECG and QT interval; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; monitor for increased sertraline side effects; avoid in patients with pre-existing QT prolongation or cardiac conditions.
